notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company; building in-app search + personalized feed. Primary objective: improve top-of-list relevance via a reranking endpoint layered on their current BM25 -> dense retrieval pipeline. Interested in Redwood Hosted API for quick POC, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation if POC metrics are met.

What they care about: p95 latency < 120ms for reranker at 25-50 QPS (peaks), offline scoring throughput for nightly re-rank of entire catalog (~2M items), deterministic fallbacks for low-capacity situations, and tight cost controls (want recommendations on batching/quantization).

POC scope (proposed):
- Offline: run 4-week eval with provided eval-set (client will supply click logs + ~1k labeled queries) using Redwood reranking endpoint in batch/offline mode; compare baseline ranking vs. reranker A/B metrics (NDCG, MRR, CTR proxy).
- Online: 2-week canary on Hosted API to measure latency/cost under production traffic pattern, then decision on Dedicated.
- Deliverables: eval report (metrics + failure cases), recommended model/quantization profile, cost estimate for Dedicated reserved capacity.

Tech notes from SE call:
- Current infra: microservices on GCP (us-east1). Data: click logs in BigQuery, content embeddings precomputed with open models.
- Preference for open checkpoints that can be quantized (8-bit) to save cost; fallback chain requested: high-accuracy reranker -> smaller reranker -> simple lexical fallback.
- Offline scoring: expect to run nightly batch re-scores for personalization; asked about SDKs or job runner for offline scoring; SE demoed Redwood batch scoring helper + KV cache usage to avoid repeated attention crunch.

Security/Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO via SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs retention 1 year, strict US residency (legal flagged export controls). Security team will re-run network/VPC review before Dedicated sign-off.

Pricing/conversation notes:
- Client asked for committed capacity pricing tiers and burst policies. Curious about how burst costs are billed when dedicated pools are exhausted. Finance requested a 36-month TCO projection vs. self-hosting + operational overhead.

Direct quotes / paraphrases: "We need reranker improvements to move CTR by 5-7% — small wins matter at scale." — Product Lead; "If the offline scoring pipeline is painful, we won't move to Dedicated" — Eng Manager.

- SE (Marcus) to provide sample offline scoring job template and estimated cost per 1M scored items (by 2026-03-01).

- Security team to complete VPC/network checklist (target complete: 2026-03-10).
